A small bug-fix release. No license or breaking changes.

[🎧 Listen to samples](https://kanaworksai-hue.github.io/audio-studio-mcp/) · [English](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp#readme) · [简体中文](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.ja.md)

## Fixes

- `generate_audio` and `edit_audio` now accept `seconds` as well as `duration_seconds` for the output length. Before, a client that sent `seconds` had it silently ignored and got the default length instead (for example 60 s of music instead of 30 s). The tool schema still names the parameter `duration_seconds`, so existing calls work as before. Fixes #7, thanks to @peercaster for the report.

## Update

From an existing clone:

```bash
git pull
```

Then restart your MCP client (or the server) so it loads the new version. Nothing needs to be reinstalled, and the model weights stay as they are.

New installs follow the README as before, using `--branch v0.2.1`.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
